title: Prove the right limit of F/G at 0 through the atTop limit along 1/s
intent: Prove the right limit lim_{t→0⁺} F(it)/G(it) = 18 π⁻² by first proving the more convenient atTop limit of FmodGReal ∘ (1/·), where the real functional equations of F and G give an explicit rational ratio, then pulling that limit back to 0 along tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero.

children.name: FmodG_numerator_tendsto
children.statement:
lemma FmodG_numerator_tendsto :
  Tendsto (fun s ↦ s ^ 2 * FReal s
    - 12 * π ^ (-1 : ℤ) * (s * ((F₁ * E₄.toFun).resToImagAxis s).re)
    + 36 * π ^ (-2 : ℤ) * (E₄.toFun.resToImagAxis s).re ^ 2) atTop (nhds (36 * π ^ (-2 : ℤ)))

children.name: FmodG_denominator_tendsto
children.statement:
lemma FmodG_denominator_tendsto :
  Tendsto (fun s ↦ (H₄.resToImagAxis s).re ^ 3
    * (2 * (H₄.resToImagAxis s).re ^ 2 + 5 * (H₂.resToImagAxis s).re * (H₄.resToImagAxis s).re
    + 5 * (H₂.resToImagAxis s).re ^ 2)) atTop (nhds 2)

children.name: F_functional_eq_real
children.statement:
lemma F_functional_eq_real {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    FReal (1 / s) = s ^ 10 * (s ^ 2 * FReal s
      - 12 * π ^ (-1 : ℤ) * (s * ((F₁ * E₄.toFun).resToImagAxis s).re)
      + 36 * π ^ (-2 : ℤ) * (E₄.toFun.resToImagAxis s).re ^ 2)

children.name: G_functional_eq_real
children.statement:
lemma G_functional_eq_real {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    GReal (1 / s) = s ^ 10 * (H₄.resToImagAxis s).re ^ 3 *
      (2 * (H₄.resToImagAxis s).re ^ 2 + 5 * (H₂.resToImagAxis s).re * (H₄.resToImagAxis s).re
        + 5 * (H₂.resToImagAxis s).re ^ 2)

applicability.goal_shape: Tendsto f (nhdsWithin a (Set.Ioi a)) L, i.e. a one-sided limit at a point, where f has a known transformation law (functional equation) that is clean under the change of variable t ↦ a + 1/s (or t ↦ 1/s for a = 0).
applicability.use_when: the target limit is inconvenient in its own neighbourhood but the function has an explicit functional equation in another coordinate, so a composed limit Tendsto (f ∘ g) atTop (nhds L) can be proved by combining named tendsto lemmas and then pulled back by a standard inversion lemma (tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero).
applicability.avoid_when: the pull-back lemma does not apply (the change of variable is not a homeomorphism onto the punctured neighbourhood, or the filter is not one of the standard inversion filters), or the functional equation does not simplify the ratio enough to leave a closed numerator/denominator pair.

consequences: Creates one intermediate obligation, the atTop limit along 1/s, whose proof must produce the two halves (numerator/denominator limits and the two real functional equations) and a cancellation of the common factor s^10; the pull-back step needs tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero to match the filter nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), so the change of variable must be the reciprocal. Failure mode: if the functional equation leaves a term that does not vanish at atTop, the numerator/denominator children no longer close on their own and the argument needs an extra decay lemma.
